partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Tissue-localized physical-neighbor intervention
results.hypothesis: A drug may treat a disease by inhibiting a tissue-localized protein that directly physically interacts with a disease-causal driver.
results.body: drug binds and decreases target -directly_physically_interacts_with[SIGNOR]- causal driver -causes-> disease; target expressed in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: Extends target selection beyond directly causal genes using a curated physical interaction and tissue localization, but an unsigned interaction does not establish propagation direction.
results.trapi_notes: The drug-target, physical-interaction, causal-driver, and anatomy motifs are TRAPI-expressible; provenance, exact absence, NPMI, and degree constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target:Gene)-[interaction:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
      <-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]-(object)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(interaction.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'NCBITaxon:9606' IN coalesce(target.in_taxon, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 200
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 5
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
      AND (
        evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
        OR evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 4
      )
    )
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
